title: PressFi
tagline: Press Finance brings ease of payment to those reporting information
description: Journalists working in developing countries need funding and faster pay for their work in order to improve and regenerate their economic cycles. Those journalists also support the ecosystem around journalism such as translators, fixers/ guides, and sources.  These ecosystem members also need to be paid.
how_its_made: Disbursements make it easy to pay journalists and allow for easy on-ramp and off ramp.
